parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The motor has an efficiency of $67\%$ . The tension in the cable is $1.6 \times 10^4\ \text{N}$ at time $t = 2.5\ \text{s}$.
Determine the input power to the motor at this time.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: State and explain whether the increase in gravitational potential energy of the lift from time $t = 0$ to $t = 7.0\ \text{s}$ is less than, the same as, or greater than the work done by the motor. A calculation is not required.
